conditions.runtime: JEM Advancement Guide optional Skarrier observation, ItemStack receipt copying, and integrated/LAN hosted-boundary admission

change.summary: Reject irrelevant Skarrier observations before snapshot allocation and bypass dedicated-only hosted boundary work in integrated/LAN worlds

modifiers.before: Every injected Skarrier procedure call created a Run and copied four ItemStacks even when the owner was not a real server player
modifiers.after: Only live real-server-player calls create the bounded Run snapshot; rejected nested calls retain balanced begin/end depth without inventory copies

modifiers.before: Every ordinary ItemStack copy asked for a battle-release receipt and allocated an empty CompoundTag when none existed
modifiers.after: Absent or invalid receipts are represented by null and allocate no CompoundTag; valid receipt copy, save and restoration semantics remain unchanged

modifiers.before: Global entity move, collision, setPos, teleport and native-tick Mixins entered hosted boundary or provenance code before later lookups discovered no integrated event
modifiers.after: Integrated and LAN logical servers return before boundary, teleport and hosted native-tick work; dedicated hosts retain the existing structure and event lifecycle

cause.owner: JEM Advancement Guide, JEM Server and JEM World Boss Tiers runtime adapters

rationale.purpose: Restore integrated-server ticking while preserving native Skarrier mechanics, advancement proof and dedicated-host arena behavior
rationale.decision_source: User runtime report and explicit 2026-10-31 request to remove JEM boundary hooks from singleplayer while retaining ForeverSMP boundaries
rationale.user_requested: Fix the item and mob freeze on a new hotfix branch, and keep boundaries out of singleplayer including LAN
rationale.codex_choices: Repair the earliest JEM allocation/admission owners instead of disabling Skarrier or masking frozen entities

introduced.summary: Add allocation-free rejection for invalid observations and dedicated-host guards for hosted boundaries

history.summary: JFR and save evidence tied the freeze to JEM snapshot allocation on broad Skarrier hooks, with boundary and hosted wrappers as integrated-world amplifiers

relations: Skarrier native procedures remain unchanged and JEM observes only eligible real-player actions
Valid battle-release receipts keep their source, actor, item and persistence proof
Integrated singleplayer and LAN use native boss combat without JEM structure or event boundaries
Dedicated hosts retain JEM structure walls, teleport admission and hosted provenance
notes: Modefite interface reflection spam is an independent render-log defect and is not treated as the freeze owner
No entity, item, progression, recipe, loot, AI or world data is rewritten
unresolved: Manual player acceptance and comparative runtime profiling of the built hotfix remain pending
